title: B-tree live page-size observation

scope.rationale: sqlite3BtreeGetPageSize returns the currently configured physical B-tree page size without locking, allocation, or side effects.

external_source_responsibilities: B-tree page-size and usable-size state maintenance
dependencies.caller_closure: The complete source observation is assigned; broader backup/pager callers remain independently owned.

inputs: Valid Btree with initialized shared page-format state
contracts.ownership: Borrowed Btree; no allocation or mutation.
contracts.state_and_results: Returns usable size plus reserved trailer bytes, the Zig model's representation of pBt.pageSize.
contracts.locks_callbacks_io: Source performs no B-tree enter/leave; caller provides safe observation context. No callbacks or I/O.
contracts.failure_and_continuation: Total for valid Btree state and has no error result.

representation_differences: The Zig Shared model stores usable_size and reserved_bytes separately, so their sum is the source pBt.pageSize field.

oracle.protocol: Set a 4,084-byte usable region and 12 reserved bytes, then observe an exact 4,096-byte page size.

assurance.io_crash_concurrency: No I/O; safe caller observation remains external.
assurance.malformed_input: Invalid Btree ownership is outside the source contract.

integration.native_call_path: Typed state owner and exact unit observation exist; backup and pager consumers remain separate.

independent_review.notes: Requires caller integration, pinned-C trace, assurance closure, and independent review.

implementation_spans: upstream/sqlite/src/btree.c:3061-3110 was reviewed completely for page-size mutation context and exact observation
callers: Unit trace invokes the owner directly
callees: No callees; direct shared state observation
assertions_branches_cleanup: The sole active return block is assigned
No branches, allocation, locking, or cleanup
